concept_attempts.feedback: Selected: low broad oval mineral body, two unequal pale-blue lenses with the larger right lens higher, dark upper/left and lighter lower/right mineral regions. Exact microrelief and socket hardware are authored; no human interior or visible shield is inferred.

issues: Original and concept show a fuller low dome; the first GLB is too flattened. Increase body height while retaining the broad compact oval silhouette.
Both lenses sit too low near the rim: move them onto the sloping front face, right remains larger/higher.
Soft body normals read like clay: retain more irregular mineral facets, without a repeating panel pattern.

final_review: Final independent GLB follows the low broad oval mineral mound, dark upper/left and lighter lower/right regions, and exactly two pale-blue lenses with the right one larger/higher. Actual feedback made the body fuller, raised lenses onto the front slope and restored restrained mineral facets. Actual shallow sockets are closed and independently checked.
limitations: Precise dome sections, underside, sockets, small weathering and lens surface detail are authored from limited fixed views.
The model does not reproduce every concept microcrevice. Lore describes personal shields but does not establish a visible field or known human interior.
No metric source height, calibrated game scale/state, Android performance or final user artistic acceptance claimed.
